inputs.units: atomic units; infinite-mass point nucleus; nonrelativistic isolated atom
inputs.boundary: u(0)=u(r_max)=0 on a uniform interior radial grid

scope: Hydrogenic radial bound states and isolated closed-shell 1s^2 helium. HF exact exchange is special to this two-electron orbital. LDA_X has zero correlation. Not molecular/periodic or a general HF/DFT solver.

independent_comparison.note: h^2 extrapolation is a consistency estimate, not a certified error bound. The Gaussian reference has its own basis/quadrature error.
